update_motd_scripts.description: List of MOTD script fragments to install in /etc/update-motd.d/. Each item is a dict with 'filename' (e.g., '00-header'), 'content' (shell script body), and 'executable' (bool, defaults to true). Optional 'priority' (int) can override filename-based ordering.

symlink_motd.description: Whether to ensure /etc/motd symlinks to /run/motd.dynamic after generation.
